analytic_position: Episodes need correction when the recorded tool result is a failure, not when the human later changes the request.

codes.label: failed edit is the correction trigger
codes.interpretation: The first durable signal is a failed edit. That is observable without reading later human text.

counterevidence.reason: E04 also has a later human correction, so failure alone is not the whole story.

themes.name: The tool result is the wound
themes.central_concept: A failed recorded result is what makes the episode look unfinished.
codes: failed edit is the correction trigger
themes.limits: Unknown results are a different class and are not treated as failures here.

questions_for_human: Should unknown results be grouped with failures or kept separate?
